normative_revisions.previous_readme_ui_motion_excerpt:
##### UI Motion

Turns decorative screen motion on or off (**PARAMS > MOSAIC > UI motion**, default On). The startup animation and selection shadows on the Masks and Trig params overview grids remain. Characters and other decorative feedback can animate on musical and status views. Editable vertical lists keep fitting labels, values, neighboring rows and controls still; they do not roll values into place or replace visible rows with previous/next-field labels. If the selected label or value is too long for its available row, only that selected text scrolls right to left with motion On. Long selected values first use a separate full-width row. With motion Off, the scrolling stops: shortened text shows `~`; an exact value that cannot fit reports `LAYOUT OVERFLOW` rather than silently displaying a different value. Screen decoration is still. The setting does not change input or sequencer timing.

The miniature-header design replaces the four-tile title mark with a small screen graphic wherever it fits in Mosaic’s title area, without covering the title, scope or controls. Normal icons occupy at most 32 × 9 pixels; Masks and Trig params use a compact 7 × 8 graphic and retain all visible controls. Native norns PARAMS keeps its own display.

While Mosaic plays, the miniature follows sequencer transport pulses. While stopped, it follows the selected norns musical clock without starting Mosaic or sounding notes. Motion Off or an unavailable or invalid clock leaves it at rest. The miniature uses musical position, not elapsed wall time. This header design’s actual-app acceptance remains pending; its preview is not a captured instrument screen.

### Sinfonion Connect

You can sync up your Eurorack Sinfonion module to Mosaic using a DIY device called [norns2sinfonion](https://github.com/subvertnormality/norns2sinfonion).

### LFOs and Modulation

_Mosaic_ works with [matrix mod](https://github.com/sixolet/matrix) and [toolkit](https://github.com/sixolet/toolkit). You can add LFOs and other rhythmic modulators to any device parameter.


## Musical Merge and Voice Leading

Mosaic can reshape a channel's merged rhythm and place its notes into stable
registers without rewriting any source pattern. Foundation and Fragments are optional strategies; Harmony defaults to Off. An older project with Merge Shape Off uses its saved legacy strategy and keeps its original MIDI, timing
